Area hierarchy for 2021 LSOAs

Source: R/geography-areas.R
lamp_area_lookup.Rd

One row per 2021 Lower layer Super Output Area in England and Wales with its 2021 Middle layer Super Output Area, 2022 local authority district, police force area and the police.uk force identifier. This is how lamp_panel() reaches the msoa21, lad and pfa levels and how it knows which areas belong to a force.

Usage

lamp_area_lookup()

Value

A tibble with columns lsoa21, lsoa21_name, msoa21, msoa21_name, lad22, lad22_name, pfa, pfa_name and force_id.

Details

Source: Office for National Statistics lookups licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0; see inst/NOTES/data_sources.md for the products and retrieval dates.

See also

Other bundled data: lamp_bank_holidays(), lamp_crime_types(), lamp_deprivation(), lamp_forces(), lamp_lsoa_lookup(), lamp_outcome_types(), lamp_sample_panel(), lamp_shocks()

Examples

lk <- lamp_area_lookup()
table(lk$force_id[lk$pfa_name == "West Yorkshire"])
#> 
#> west-yorkshire 
#>           1404 
length(unique(lk$msoa21))
#> [1] 7264
